title: Bubblebear player model texture pack
description: You can now play as Bubblebear from "Lucid Blocks" the game, made by Lucy B Blocks. It changes player models and damage sounds. Have fun!
body:
![player model example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9a67ddd826f1b0b80a7425ace756d843bdcac33.png)

Hello, I'm new here, that's actually my first work. Here is what you should know about this pack:

1. Replace every player model (9 kinds) to bubblebear models (3 kinds) (actually textures,you know, png ones, not models)
2. Replace every in-game sounds of "player taking damage" to bubblebear ones

Aaaaand that's all for now. I actually plan some stuff for later, like changing some minecraft music discs with ones which would play lucid blocks music, or add some custom weapons from there, but that's for later. And for now- have fun! (I hope you will)(also try out Lucid Blocks, that's not an ad, I just played it and really enjoed it, and hope you will as well)
